verdict_reason: Automatic first pass. The video's sum shows +£951 a month. At a price of 1,655,330 MAD (£125,842), 13% under the asking price, you would put in about £334 a month, inside your £400 limit; a weak year would need £439. 32 of the 52 nearby Airbnbs take enough to keep you inside it. At the full asking price it would be £415 a month, over the limit. After 25 years the flat is yours and should then pay you about £168 a month.
